read_detection_method.method: Allseven modules manually inspected; balanced object.get and val parsing plus exact direct/parameter/dictionary paths. val(a,field) has two closed actual callers and is expanded to both offspring date leaves. Contextual receiver aliases separate animal replacement r/r2 in holding/reporting from static data-table r in premium/participation. Not a general complete Rego analyzer.
blind_spots_corrected: Historical scanner records only farm.year and direct documentation.vis_reports_complete; object.get, val, individual-animal aliases and nested events require actual tracing.

Same variable r denotes static data rows in premium/participation, but replacement animals in holding/reporting. Unscoped scanning would invent unmanaged category/rate_period/reason/stage paths or miss replacement_reported_date.
Generic val definition obj/key is not an independent unknown input. Its two actual dynamic offspring keys are explicitly expanded.
Arraycontainer reads are preserved at exact path; [] in expanded leaves denotes repeated animal or temporary-absence record, not an object field name or scalar container type.
